exposure: Ovarian storage temperature (4, 14, 37 degrees C, RT)
cohort: Ovaries from 4-week-old C57BL/6J mice were harvested, stored, and then orthotopically transplanted into 6-week-old C57BL/6J mice for fertility assessment.
finding: Prolonging the ovarian storage time, specifically beyond 4 hours at 4 degrees C, significantly reduces the implantation rate and live birth rate in mice.
